headline.caveat: up to $27B over five years: ~$12B of dedicated capacity plus a commitment to purchase up to ~$15B of additional capacity

realized_to_date.caveat: deliveries begin early 2027 as new clusters come online; nothing material realized yet

nature_md: Five-year AI-infrastructure agreement (announced Mar 16, 2026) under which Nebius delivers ~$12B of dedicated capacity to Meta across multiple locations — among the first large-scale deployments of NVIDIA's Vera Rubin platform — plus Meta's commitment to purchase up to ~$15B of additional compute over the same period, for a total of up to $27B. The additional-capacity clusters will primarily serve other Nebius AI-cloud customers, with Meta taking remaining available compute. Alongside Microsoft's $17.4–19.4B contract, this puts Nebius's contracted backlog near $46B.

accounting.payer_treatment_md: Purchase commitment; expensed as compute is consumed. The 'up to $15B' tranche is an option-like commitment — headline overstates the guaranteed minimum.
accounting.payee_treatment_md: Backlog/RPO for Nebius; the dedicated $12B portion is the firmer component. Nebius funds the buildout with capex of $16–20B in 2026, partly debt raised against contracted revenue.
